blurb: Gallery 2112 proudly presents Kaleidoscope. A solo exhibition of paintings by artist, Padme. Kaleidoscope is a celebration of 'art from the heart'-a visual reminder that even through all the chaos in the world, there is still a sacred pattern to be found. Exhibit runs MAY 21 - 31, 2026. Join us for Third Thursdays - May 21, 2026, 5-8pm.
